body:
Wall time, measured (by the M5 coordinator, not a review):

| Run | Machine | Budget | Result | Wall |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| post-merge gate on main e5b0ca3c1 (current serial batch tier) | wopr: Ryzen 9 5950X, 16 cores / 32 threads, 125 GB | serial | green | **73 min** (first run, cold cache) |
| `cargo xtask gate batch` on this head `1da2bcca2` | same machine, warm local sccache | default 6 jobs (3 lanes) | green, 929 steps | **30.8 min** |

A second run with `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=32` on the same machine is running now; its number follows. The default budget of 6 leaves a 32-thread runner mostly idle (load ~15), so the runner `.env` (or a budget from the core count) is the next lever.

Second measurement, same machine (wopr, 16 cores / 32 threads), same head `1da2bcca2`, warm cache: `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=32 cargo xtask gate batch` -> green, 929 steps, **14.4 min** (864 s). So: serial batch 73 min -> this PR at the default budget 30.8 min -> this PR at budget 32 **14.4 min**. Suggestion for a follow-up (not this PR): take the default budget from the core count (or set CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS in each runner's .env), since a fixed 6 leaves big runners idle.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 1da2bcca26b647409cd7673154b341365ccb2242 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** The review found no blockers.

This PR changes only `xtask/`, `AGENTS.md`, the `gate` skill and one decision file. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, the stock simulation or geometry. It is not a safety-tier review. It has no `crates/ui` change, so it needs no screenshots.

## What looks good

- The cause is correct. `crates/kernel` has a dev-dependency on itself with the `truck` feature. One build of all the crates gives the shared crates a different feature set than a step with one `-p <crate>`.
- `plan::batch` has one `--no-run` step for each crate (`xtask/src/plan.rs:152`, `:179`). The ui build runs in `crates/ui`, as the ui steps do.
- The batch tier uses the executor of the release tier without a copy (`xtask/src/queue.rs:30`). The rules of `lanes::alone` are not changed: the builds, the `ISOLATED` targets, each ui step and clippy run alone.
- The gate keeps its guarantees. A failed build stops the run (`queue.rs:62`). The checkout is read before each step. A red step gives exit code 1.
- The release queue still reads `release-*` runs only (`xtask/src/lanes.rs:122`). The `release_with` change is a refactor to `debug_build(ALL_CRATES)` with the same arguments.
- The pins are real tests. One runs two steps that wait for each other, so it fails if the steps do not overlap. One builds a fixture workspace and reads the `fresh` field of cargo.
- The body has `Process change: yes`, a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #2727`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The decision file has the correct format.

## Results merged with main

Built locally (an `xtask/` change is not built on the runner). Worktree of head `1da2bcca2`, trial merge with `upstream/main` `3970d3d03`: no conflict. #2779 is merged, so the stack is resolved.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | pass: 213 tests (191 unit, 22 integration) |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass: no warnings |
| `cargo xtask gate batch --dry-run` | 943 steps on the merged tree: 9 builds alone, 885 steps in the queue (3 lanes x `-j 2`), 49 steps alone |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | falls back to batch on the merged tree and uses the lanes |
| Real run: `cargo xtask gate batch --only "debug build: cl" --only "cl suites" --only "debug build: tools" --only "tools suites"` | green: 16 steps, 2 builds alone, 14 steps in 3 lanes. No suite log has a `Compiling` line. `timings.tsv` is written. |

I did not run the full batch gate. The body has three green runs of 929 steps on this head.

Mutations that I ran again (all three applied, then restored from the index):

| Mutation | Pin | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `Run::new`: `lanes` on for `release` only | `batch_executor_overlaps_lanes_runs_isolated_alone_and_writes_timings` | red (`lanes_tests.rs:257`); green after the restore |
| `lanes::history_for`: `batch` reads `release-*` only | `batch_history_reads_newest_batch_or_falls_back_to_release` | red (`lanes_tests.rs:276`); green after the restore |
| `plan::batch`: one `debug_build` for all the crates | `batch_prebuilds_each_crate_without_mixing_feature_sets`, `batch_prebuild_leaves_suite_steps_fresh_with_truck_dev_dep`, `batch_skips_slow_binaries_and_release_runs_everything`, `batch_runs_lib_and_each_non_slow_binary_one_step_each` | red (`step_tests.rs:85`, `:152`, `:64`, `tests.rs:192`); green after the restore |

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directory and no import code.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. `xtask/src/queue.rs:44` - a run with `--only` or `--failed` also writes `batch-*/timings.tsv`. The next full batch run reads that file as its history (`xtask/src/lanes.rs:135`). Most steps then have no time, and the queue keeps the plan order. My 16-step run made such a file. This changes only the order, not the result. The gate skill recommends `--only` runs, so this occurs frequently for batch. A follow-up can skip the write for a selected plan.
2. Commit `41cf2fcf1` has the type `wip`. `AGENTS.md` does not list that type. The branch has an open PR, so the commit cannot be rewritten (no force-push). `main` already has two such subjects. The fixing commit `1da2bcca2` has a correct subject.
3. `xtask/src/exec.rs:238` - in the lanes, the line `ok in Ns` does not name its step. Two results that come together cannot be told apart in the console output. The summary table and the logs are correct. The release tier had this already; each batch run shows it now.
4. `.claude/skills/gate/SKILL.md:56` says that a batch plan has about 700 steps. The plan has 943 steps now.
5. The default job budget of 6 gives 3 lanes. The measurement comments show 30.8 min with 6 jobs and 14.4 min with 32 jobs on the runner. A budget from the core count, or `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS` in the runner `.env`, is a follow-up, not a part of this PR.
6. The first line of the body says "merge #2779 first". #2779 is merged. The line is out of date and does no harm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
